facts.fact: Universal Ads has no minimum media spend for its premium TV advertising campaigns in the UK.
facts.quote: Universal Ads has no minimum spend and is designed to make premium TV accessible to businesses

facts.fact: Through Universal Ads, small and medium sized businesses can access premium TV inventory across Channel 4 Sales, ITV Media and Sky Media in one unified campaign.
facts.quote: small and medium sized businesses can access premium TV inventory across Channel 4 Sales, ITV Media and Sky Media in one unified campaign

facts.fact: Universal Ads requires uploaded TV creative to be Clearcast-approved before a campaign launches.
facts.quote: Upload your Clearcast-approved creative, and your campaign is ready to launch.

facts.fact: Universal Ads campaigns can be targeted using genres viewers like to watch.
facts.quote: Once you’ve selected your audience using targeting options like the genres they love to watch

facts.fact: Universal Ads' UK premium TV campaigns are set up in three steps: activate account, set budget and choose audience, and upload TV-ready advert.
facts.quote: Get Your Business on TV in the UK in 3 Simple Steps
